notes: The M3-2 full report supersedes the M3-1 advance (durable-goods-2026-10-27) for the same September 2026 reference month, seven days later. Initial research 2026-09-06 confirms the December twin's finding — M3-2's nowcast footprint is indistinguishable from a vintage naming no M3 report at all (|d equipment| 0.0033pp, n=16, permutation p=0.660 against 1,540 no-M3 vintages, while the M3-1 advance moves 0.0346pp at p=0.00005) — on an independently built classifier that resolves ambiguous free-text tokens by joining to the Census calendar. Two findings are this edition's own. FIRST, this edition's GDPNow vintage is structurally unobservable: GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx carries NO PostedUpdates row for 2026-11-03 (the posted rows either side are 11-02 "Construction spending, ISM Manufacturing Index" and 11-04 "International trade (Full report), ISM Services"), only an InternalUpdates row naming "M3-2 Manufacturing (Full report)" alone — so m3-full-report-2026-12-03's kill switch, which names 2026-10-02 and 2026-11-03 as its next two candidate M3-2-alone vintages, cannot fire on either. SECOND, 2026-11-03 is US midterm Election Day (tracked high-tier midterm-elections-2026-11-03) and this is only the second M3-2 release ever to land on a federal election day; the precedent, 2020-11-03, was also Census-solo and also named alone, and saw GDPNow move 0.0084pp while SPY ranged 2.369% — past the baseline p90. The session is unmeasurable, not quiet. By scheduling this is the series' modal edition: Census-solo (69 of 84 are), 2nd business day (40 of 84), a 7-day advance-to-full gap (32 of 83) and a 34-day reference-lag that is the exact median of all 84.
